Native bootstrap kits

Download ncc.

Get the ncc compiler for the nC programming language. The V81 kit includes the native candidate and its runtime provider, with a documented partial bootstrap command set.

Native PE compiler and DLL provider. Keep both files in the same directory.

Before you start

Review SHA-256 checksums, requirements and smoke-test results in the release notes. These bootstrap candidates do not automatically replace an existing installation.

Notes, hashes and instructions ↗

Working from source

Building Stage0 requires a verified native seed. The guide explains seed selection and the archiver required by each host.
